home.heroSubtitle: P2P se aap directly doosre logon ke saath coins trade kar sakte hain. Hamara escrow aur dispute system har trade ko secure rakhta hai.
home.howItWorksSubtitle: Paxones par trading simple, secure aur fast hai. In 3 easy steps ka follow karein aur apni P2P journey start karein.
home.step1Desc: Sirf User ID se free signup karein. Simple identity verification complete karein taaki account secure ho aur trading start ho sake.
home.step2Desc: Doosre users ke buy ya sell ads browse karein. Coin, payment method aur amount se filter karke perfect match find karein.
home.step3Desc: Trade initiate karein aur apne partner se secure chat ke through communicate karein. Seller ka coin escrow me lock hota hai safety ke liye.
home.step4Desc: Jab buyer pay kar deta hai aur seller confirm kar deta hai, coin instantly escrow se buyer ke wallet me release ho jata hai.
home.whyP2PTitle: P2P Platform par Trade kyun karein?
home.whyP2PSubtitle: Peer-to-peer (P2P) trading traditional exchanges se unique advantages deta hai. Directly doosre logon ke saath trade karein aur apne price aur payment methods par control rakhein.
home.directTradingDesc: Middleman hata dein. Aap directly doosre person ke saath negotiate aur trade karein, jo better rates aur faster transactions deta hai.
home.globalPaymentsDesc: Hundreds of payment methods me se choose karein, including local bank transfer, online wallets aur aur bhi, taaki kahi se bhi trade karna easy ho.
home.controlDesc: Apni price set karein, terms define karein aur decide karein kisse trade karna hai. P2P freedom deta hai jo traditional platforms nahi de sakte.
home.securitySubtitle: Hamne multi-layered security features ke saath platform design kiya hai taaki har trade start se finish tak secure rahe.
home.escrowDesc: Jab trade start hota hai, seller ka coin automatically secure temporary vault (escrow) me transfer hota hai. Funds tabhi release hote hain jab seller confirm kar deta hai ki payment receive ho gaya hai. Ye seller fraud aur buyer protection ke liye hai.
home.disputeDesc: Agar kabhi disagreement hota hai, hamari dedicated support team help ke liye ready hai. Kisi bhi party se dispute initiate ho sakta hai. Moderators trade details, chat logs aur payment evidence carefully review karte hain aur fair decision lete hain.
home.supportedCoinsDesc: Ham popular digital assets ka growing list support karte hain aur naye coins regular add kiye ja rahe hain.

footer.tagline: Confidence ke saath trade karein. Paxones ek trusted escrow system ke saath secure P2P platform provide karta hai.
